cues.zh: 我要讲一个我遇到的问题
cues.en: So I'm going to speak about a problem that I have

cues.zh: 那就是我是个哲学家。
cues.en: and that's that I'm a philosopher.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.en: When I go to a party and people ask me what do I do

cues.zh: 我说：“我是教授”，他们的眼神就变得呆滞了。
cues.en: and I say, "I'm a professor," their eyes glaze over.

cues.zh: 我去参加学术圈的鸡尾酒会
cues.en: When I go to an academic cocktail party

cues.zh: 周围全是教授，他们问我研究什么领域
cues.en: and there are all the professors around, they ask me what field I'm in

cues.zh: 我说：“哲学”——他们的眼神就变得呆滞了。
cues.en: and I say, "philosophy" -- their eyes glaze over.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 我去参加哲学家的派对
cues.en: When I go to a philosopher's party

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 他们问我研究什么，我说“意识”，
cues.en: and they ask me what I work on and I say, "consciousness,"

cues.zh: 他们的眼神不会呆滞——他们的嘴角会撇成一副凶相。
cues.en: their eyes don't glaze over -- their lips curl into a snarl.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 然后我就招来一片嘲笑、窃笑和低吼
cues.en: And I get hoots of derision and cackles and growls

cues.zh: 因为他们想：“这不可能！你没法解释意识。”
cues.en: because they think, "That's impossible! You can't explain consciousness."

cues.zh: 居然有人觉得自己能解释意识
cues.en: The very chutzpah of somebody thinking

cues.zh: 这种狂妄简直不可理喻。
cues.en: that you could explain consciousness is just out of the question.

cues.zh: 我已故的、令人怀念的朋友鲍勃·诺齐克，一位杰出的哲学家，
cues.en: My late, lamented friend Bob Nozick, a fine philosopher,

cues.zh: 在他的一本书《哲学解释》中，
cues.en: in one of his books, "Philosophical Explanations,"

cues.zh: 评论了哲学的精神气质——
cues.en: is commenting on the ethos of philosophy --

cues.zh: 即哲学家们做事的方式。
cues.en: the way philosophers go about their business.

cues.zh: 他说，你知道，“哲学家热爱理性的论证。”
cues.en: And he says, you know, "Philosophers love rational argument."

cues.zh: 他说，“似乎对大多数哲学家来说，理想的论证
cues.en: And he says, "It seems as if the ideal argument

cues.zh: 就是你给听众前提，
cues.en: for most philosophers is you give your audience the premises

cues.zh: 然后给他们推理过程和结论，
cues.en: and then you give them the inferences and the conclusion,

cues.zh: 如果他们不接受结论，他们就死。
cues.en: and if they don't accept the conclusion, they die.

cues.zh: 他们的脑袋会炸开。”这个想法是要有一个论证，
cues.en: Their heads explode." The idea is to have an argument

cues.zh: 强大到足以击倒你的对手。
cues.en: that is so powerful that it knocks out your opponents.

cues.zh: 但事实上，这根本不会改变人们的想法。
cues.en: But in fact that doesn't change people's minds at all.

cues.zh: 要改变人们对诸如意识之类问题的想法
cues.en: It's very hard to change people's minds

cues.zh: 是非常困难的，
cues.en: about something like consciousness,

cues.zh: 而我终于想明白了其中的原因。
cues.en: and I finally figured out the reason for that.

cues.zh: 原因在于，每个人都是意识方面的专家。
cues.en: The reason for that is that everybody's an expert on consciousness.

cues.zh: 前几天我们听说，每个人对电子游戏都有强烈的看法。
cues.en: We heard the other day that everybody's got a strong opinion about video games.

cues.zh: 他们都有关于电子游戏的想法，即使他们不是专家。
cues.en: They all have an idea for a video game, even if they're not experts.

cues.zh: 但他们并不认为自己是电子游戏方面的专家；
cues.en: But they don't consider themselves experts on video games;

cues.zh: 他们只是有强烈的观点。
cues.en: they've just got strong opinions.

cues.zh: 我相信这里从事气候变化研究的人，
cues.en: I'm sure that people here who work on, say, climate change

cues.zh: 比如全球变暖，或者互联网的未来，
cues.en: and global warming, or on the future of the Internet,

cues.zh: 会遇到那些持有非常强烈观点的人
cues.en: encounter people who have very strong opinions

cues.zh: 关于接下来会发生什么。
cues.en: about what's going to happen next.

cues.zh: 但他们可能不会把这些观点视为专业知识。
cues.en: But they probably don't think of these opinions as expertise.

cues.zh: 它们只是坚定的观点。
cues.en: They're just strongly held opinions.

cues.zh: 但关于意识，人们似乎认为，
cues.en: But with regard to consciousness, people seem to think,

cues.zh: 我们每个人似乎都认为，“我是专家。
cues.en: each of us seems to think, "I am an expert.

cues.zh: 仅仅因为我有意识，我就对此了如指掌。”
cues.en: Simply by being conscious, I know all about this."

cues.zh: 于是，你跟他们讲你的理论，他们说，
cues.en: And so, you tell them your theory and they say,

cues.zh: “不，不，意识不是那样的！
cues.en: "No, no, that's not the way consciousness is!

cues.zh: 不，你完全搞错了。”
cues.en: No, you've got it all wrong."

cues.zh: 而且他们说这话时带着惊人的自信。
cues.en: And they say this with an amazing confidence.

cues.zh: 所以我今天想做的
cues.en: And so what I'm going to try to do today

cues.zh: 就是动摇你们的信心。因为我懂那种感觉——
cues.en: is to shake your confidence. Because I know the feeling --

cues.zh: 我自己也能感受到。
cues.en: I can feel it myself.

cues.zh: 我想动摇你们这样一种信心：你们了解自己内心深处的想法——
cues.en: I want to shake your confidence that you know your own innermost minds --

cues.zh: 即你们对自己意识具有权威性。
cues.en: that you are, yourselves, authoritative about your own consciousness.

cues.zh: 这就是今天的主题。
cues.en: That's the order of the day here.

cues.en: Now, this nice picture shows a thought-balloon, a thought-bubble.

cues.en: I think everybody understands what that means.

cues.en: That's supposed to exhibit the stream of consciousness.

cues.en: This is my favorite picture of consciousness that's ever been done.

cues.en: And this fellow here is looking at the painting by Braque.

cues.en: That reminds him of the word baroque, barrack, bark, poodle,

cues.en: Suzanne R. -- he's off to the races.

cues.zh: 这里有一段很妙的意识流，
cues.en: There's a wonderful stream of consciousness here

cues.en: and if you follow it along, you learn a lot about this man.

cues.zh: 我特别喜欢这幅画的另一点是，
cues.en: What I particularly like about this picture, too,

cues.zh: Steinberg 把这个人画成了
cues.en: is that Steinberg has rendered the guy

cues.zh: 这种点彩派的风格。
cues.en: in this sort of pointillist style.

cues.zh: 这让我们想起，正如 Rod Brooks 昨天所说：
cues.en: Which reminds us, as Rod Brooks was saying yesterday:

cues.zh: 我们是什么，我们每个人是什么——你是什么，我是什么——
cues.en: what we are, what each of us is -- what you are, what I am --

cues.zh: 大约是 100 万亿个微小的细胞机器人。
cues.en: is approximately 100 trillion little cellular robots.

cues.zh: 我们就是由这些构成的。
cues.en: That's what we're made of.

cues.zh: 没有任何其他成分。我们只是由细胞组成，大约 100 万亿个。
cues.en: No other ingredients at all. We're just made of cells, about 100 trillion of them.

cues.zh: 这些细胞中没有一个是具有意识的；
cues.en: Not a single one of those cells is conscious;

cues.zh: 这些细胞中没有一个知道你是谁，也不在乎。
cues.en: not a single one of those cells knows who you are, or cares.

cues.zh: 我们总得解释
cues.en: Somehow, we have to explain

cues.zh: 当你把成团队、成军团、成营的
cues.en: how when you put together teams, armies, battalions

cues.zh: 数亿个无意识的微小机器人细胞组合在一起时——
cues.en: of hundreds of millions of little robotic unconscious cells --

cues.zh: 每一个其实和细菌差不太多——
cues.en: not so different really from a bacterium, each one of them --

cues.zh: 结果就是这个。你看一眼就知道了。
cues.en: the result is this. I mean, just look at it.

cues.zh: 内容——有色彩，有思想，有记忆，
cues.en: The content -- there's color, there's ideas, there's memories,

cues.zh: 有历史。而意识的所有这些内容
cues.en: there's history. And somehow all that content of consciousness

cues.zh: 竟然是由那一大群神经元的繁忙活动完成的。
cues.en: is accomplished by the busy activity of those hoards of neurons.

cues.zh: 这怎么可能？很多人干脆认为这根本不可能。
cues.en: How is that possible? Many people just think it isn't possible at all.

cues.zh: 他们想：“不，不可能存在
cues.en: They think, "No, there can't be any

cues.zh: 任何对意识的自然主义解释。”
cues.en: sort of naturalistic explanation of consciousness."

cues.zh: 这是我朋友Lee Siegel写的一本好书，
cues.en: This is a lovely book by a friend of mine named Lee Siegel,

cues.zh: 他其实是夏威夷大学的宗教学教授，
cues.en: who's a professor of religion, actually, at the University of Hawaii,

cues.zh: 同时也是个专业魔术师，还是
cues.en: and he's an expert magician, and an expert

cues.zh: 印度街头魔术的专家，这本书讲的就是这个，
cues.en: on the street magic of India, which is what this book is about,

cues.zh: “魔法净值。”
cues.en: "Net of Magic."

cues.zh: 其中有一段，我很想和你们分享。
cues.en: And there's a passage in it which I would love to share with you.

cues.zh: 它非常雄辩地说明了这个问题。
cues.en: It speaks so eloquently to the problem.

cues.zh: “我正在写一本关于魔术的书，”我解释道，然后有人问我：“真正的魔术？”
cues.en: "'I'm writing a book on magic,' I explain, and I'm asked, 'Real magic?'

cues.zh: 所谓“真正的魔术”，人们指的是奇迹、
cues.en: By 'real magic,' people mean miracles,

cues.zh: 法术行为以及超自然力量。
cues.en: thaumaturgical acts, and supernatural powers.

cues.zh: “不，”我回答。“是魔术把戏，不是真正的魔术。”
cues.en: 'No,' I answer. 'Conjuring tricks, not real magic.'

cues.zh: 换句话说，“真正的魔术”指的是并不真实的魔术；
cues.en: 'Real magic,' in other words, refers to the magic that is not real;

cues.zh: 而真实的、实际能表演的魔术，反倒不是真正的魔术。”
cues.en: while the magic that is real, that can actually be done, is not real magic."

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 很多人对意识的看法正是如此。
cues.en: Now, that's the way a lot of people feel about consciousness.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 真正的意识不是一堆把戏。
cues.en: Real consciousness is not a bag of tricks.

cues.zh: 如果你要把它解释成一堆把戏，
cues.en: If you're going to explain this as a bag of tricks,

cues.zh: 那它就不是真正的意识，不管它是什么。
cues.en: then it's not real consciousness, whatever it is.

cues.zh: 而且，正如 Marvin 所说，也正如其他人所说，
cues.en: And, as Marvin said, and as other people have said,

cues.zh: “意识就是一堆把戏。”
cues.en: "Consciousness is a bag of tricks."

cues.zh: 这就意味着，很多人对此完全不满
cues.en: This means that a lot of people are just left completely dissatisfied

cues.zh: 而且当我试图解释意识时，他们满腹狐疑。
cues.en: and incredulous when I attempt to explain consciousness.

cues.zh: 所以这就是问题所在。因此我得
cues.en: So this is the problem. So I have to

cues.zh: 做一点那种
cues.en: do a little bit of the sort of work

cues.zh: 你们很多人不会喜欢的工作，
cues.en: that a lot of you won't like,

cues.zh: 原因就在于你们不喜欢看到
cues.en: for the same reason that you don't like to see

cues.zh: 魔术被揭秘。
cues.en: a magic trick explained to you.

cues.zh: 在座有多少人，如果有人——某个自作聪明的人——
cues.en: How many of you here, if somebody -- some smart aleck --

cues.zh: 开始告诉你某个魔术是怎么变的，
cues.en: starts telling you how a particular magic trick is done,

cues.zh: 你会想捂住耳朵说：“不，不，我不想知道！
cues.en: you sort of want to block your ears and say, "No, no, I don't want to know!

cues.zh: 别把那份刺激感拿走。我宁愿被蒙在鼓里。
cues.en: Don't take the thrill of it away. I'd rather be mystified.

cues.zh: 别告诉我答案。”
cues.en: Don't tell me the answer."

cues.zh: 我发现，很多人对意识也是这种感觉。
cues.en: A lot of people feel that way about consciousness, I've discovered.

cues.zh: 如果我硬要给你们带来一些清晰、一些理解，我很抱歉。
cues.en: And I'm sorry if I impose some clarity, some understanding on you.

cues.zh: 你要是不想知道这些把戏，最好现在就走。
cues.en: You'd better leave now if you don't want to know some of these tricks.

cues.en: But I'm not going to explain it all to you.

cues.en: I'm going to do what philosophers do.

cues.en: Here's how a philosopher explains the sawing-the-lady-in-half trick.

cues.en: You know the sawing-the-lady-in-half trick?

cues.en: You see, the magician doesn't really saw the lady in half."

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.en: "He merely makes you think that he does."

cues.en: And you say, "Yes, and how does he do that?"

cues.en: He says, "Oh, that's not my department, I'm sorry."

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.en: So now I'm going to illustrate how philosophers explain consciousness.

cues.en: But I'm going to try to also show you

cues.en: your own consciousness isn't quite as wonderful --

cues.zh: 可能没你想的那么了不起。
cues.en: as you may have thought it is.

cues.en: This is something, by the way, that Lee Siegel talks about in his book.

cues.en: He didn't even try to do those things.

cues.en: People's memories inflate what they think they saw.

cues.en: And the same is true of consciousness.
